description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for different models, with the x-axis labeled "Co-occurrence Number" on a logarithmic scale ranging from 10^1 to 10^3, and the y-axis labeled "ACC (%)" on a linear scale from 60 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot displays four lines for each of the models MEND, MEMIT, and ROME, with different colors and marker shapes, and three editing methods, Base, FT, and IKE, also represented by distinct colors and marker shapes. The black line with circle markers representing Base starts at around 65% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and increases to approximately 78% at 10^3. The blue line with downward triangle markers representing FT begins at around 66% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and rises to about 80% at 10^3. The red line with upward triangle markers representing IKE starts at roughly 67% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and reaches around 83% at 10^3. The brown line with diamond markers representing MEND begins at approximately 75% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and increases to about 88% at 10^3. The purple line with triangle markers representing MEMIT starts at around 73% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and rises to approximately 90% at 10^3. The green line with square markers representing ROME begins at roughly 76% ACC at a Co-occurrence Number of 10 and reaches around 92% at 10^3. All lines exhibit a generally increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
